comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-16, second sighting (a_2is4efRU1): two stuck Codex panes on the devenv, recovered by hand. The steps that worked, which a restart request would automate: (1) drain the terminal's input from the slave side until it stays empty, since the daemon refills it from its own queue (a_2is4QBDSZ) and the shell reads whatever is left once the program exits; (2) SIGTERM the program, which leaves its shell at a prompt; (3) type `codex resume <session id>`. The id came from the main thread's rollout file the process held open (session_meta source "cli"; guardian and spawned sub-agent rollouts are open too and must be skipped), because the panes ran plain `codex` and the adapter's reported session id was not to hand. SIGWINCH and emptying the queue alone did not get Codex reading again. Both sessions came back intact.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-07 with the stuck state (GitHub issue #1 part 2). The notice for a program that stopped reading its input now names the program and offers no Reattach, since reattaching cannot help. The way out is interrupting the program, or ending it and resuming its session - but Muster has no request that restarts an agent in place, and adding one is destructive enough to need its own decision: what it kills, whether it resumes the session with the flags it ran with (the daemon-restart resume path already knows how), and what it asks first.
title: 🔁 Restart a stuck agent from its notice
